texts: good. the rule fires for any keeper located at the Hollows, "often" lands as a 0.8-strength rule with the word recorded beside it, and the lanterns are carried as the object of the tending. Worth knowing, though it needs no rewrite: "in pairs" survives only as the surface phrase attached to the tending, so the two-at-a-time count is not stored as a number and a question like "how many keepers tend a lantern together?" will not resolve.

good. every part lands — the keepers as one group at the Hollows, the weekly recurrence, the shed as the meeting place, and the shed's position at the edge of the forest — and "meet" is correctly kept as a single group event rather than split into one meeting per keeper.
